title: Clean Live TV Return, Guaranteed First-Try Channel Play & VOD Seek Engine
releaseNotes:
• Clean Return to Live TV: Returning to Live TV from Movies, Series, or any other module now cleanly restores the 'Select a channel on the left to start streaming' message on the preview screen, with zero leftover VOD titles or lingering playback frames
• Guaranteed First-Try Channel Playback: Clicking any channel now immediately begins streaming on the first press — eliminated the issue where the previous channel state blocked playback and required navigating down and up to register
• Complete Media State Reset: ExoPlayerManager stop() now thoroughly purges stream URLs, titles, and live playback tokens upon leaving modules, ensuring Live TV starts from a pristine preview state
• Scrubbing Throttle & Debounce: Remote fast-forward and rewind scrubbing now debounces network Range requests by 350ms while keeping real-time UI magnitude feedback (+30s, +1m) — completely preventing the burst of aborted HTTP requests that caused 'Connection interrupted (HTTP error)' crashes when seeking
• Fast VOD Playback Startup: Optimized loadControl buffer thresholds (800ms initial buffer) for instant startup on Hulu, FX, and high-bitrate series like 'The Drop'
• Failsafe Auto-Reboot & Resume: If an unrecoverable stream error occurs after all retries, the app automatically executes an internal media engine reboot and seamlessly returns to programming at the exact saved playback position without requiring a manual reboot
